routes.name: CR227 one-interaction audit and conditional transfer

C9000227.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 227 (Critical SK autocorrelation processes and dynamics across the temperature transition.; papers: Universality of critical quench autocorrelations in the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model; Functional universality of critical SK autocorrelations; A spectral gap throughout the high-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick phase; Cutoff throughout the high-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick phase; Critical slowing down in the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model; Stretched-exponential barriers for typical SK initial states; A typical-start upper bound for low-temperature SK Glauber dynamics; Critical mixing in the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/227.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_CR227_ALGEBRA.statement: The binary conditional tilt, endpoint energy multiplier, residual cancellation, and finite variational completion identities hold with the manuscript's half-difference convention.

C_CR227_RESIDUAL.statement: For arbitrary real base disorder, the residual identity and source-44 through source-46 hold for both features, with T=n^(2/3).

C_CR227_DERIVATIVE.statement: Compactified finite collections of traces satisfy the localized fourth-derivative bound, including interaction windows 2(log n)^2/sqrt(n).

C_CR227_STATIC.statement: The exponential quenched overlap tail and polynomially weighted correlation conclusion hold uniformly over Gaussian mixtures with centered variance-one zero-third-moment disorder having a two-sided exponential moment.

A_CR227_GTRACE.statement: Unverified Gaussian input: joint convergence of the first-feature traces to finite transforms of a random nonnegative spectral measure, as in prop:trace-goe and source-40.

A_CR227_GQUAD.statement: Unverified Gaussian input: the quadratic-feature trace tends to zero in probability for every z>0, as in prop:trace-second and source-43.

C_CR227_COMPARISON.statement: Conditional on the two Gaussian inputs, the same joint resolvent limits hold for iid Cramer-class zero-third-moment disorder, including symmetric variance-one sub-Gaussian disorder.

C_CR227_SPECTRAL.statement: Joint convergence of the Stieltjes transforms at positive parameters implies convergence of the positive-time Laplace transforms in C_loc((0,infinity)).

C_CR227_FUNCTIONAL.statement: Conditional on the explicitly retained Gaussian trace and quadratic-feature inputs, the critical stationary autocorrelation process for iid Cramer-class zero-third-moment disorder has the same positive-time functional limit and clock.
